title: WikiOriginQA: Automated Construction of a QA Dataset with Knowledge Origins for Analyzing Cultural Bias
abstract: arXiv:2610.30677v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Existing datasets on cultural knowledge have been typically created by human annotators familiar with each culture. However, the process requires considerable human effort, presenting a significant challenge to scalability. To address this challenge, we introduce WikiOriginQA, a QA dataset automatically constructed by objectively representing the origins of knowledge through the creation dates of different Wikipedia language editions. Experimental results with the created dataset confirm that LLM performance tends to be biased toward Anglophone cultures. Furthermore, the results suggest the importance of knowledge propagation into the Anglosphere. These findings demonstrate the validity of our automated approach, enabling cultural bias evaluations with superior scalability across diverse languages without extensive manual annotation.

translated_title: WikiOriginQA：用于分析文化偏见的、包含知识来源信息的问答数据集的自动化构建
translated_abstract: 现有关于文化知识的数据集通常由熟悉各自文化的人类标注者创建。然而，这一过程需要大量人力投入，给可扩展性带来了重大挑战。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了WikiOriginQA，这是一个通过不同语言版本的维基百科创建日期来客观表征知识来源、进而自动构建的问答数据集。基于该数据集的实验结果证实，大语言模型（LLM）的性能往往偏向英语文化。此外，结果表明知识向英语圈传播的重要性。这些发现验证了我们自动化方法的有效性，使得无需大量人工标注即可跨多种语言以卓越的可扩展性进行文化偏见评估。
tldr: 提出WikiOriginQA，利用维基百科不同语言版本的创建日期客观表征知识来源并自动构建问答数据集，实现无需人工标注的可扩展文化偏见评估，实验发现大语言模型存在偏向英语文化的偏见，且知识向英语圈的传播至关重要。
en_tdlr: We propose WikiOriginQA, a QA dataset automatically constructed by objectively representing knowledge origins through the creation dates of different Wikipedia language editions, enabling scalable cultural bias evaluation without manual annotation and revealing LLM bias toward Anglophone cultures as well as the importance of knowledge propagation into the Anglosphere.
